title: Game Jam
description: BetaDev holdings a semiannual gamejam! If you want to create a game, learn game development or want to have some fun — join the gamejam!
heading: Game Jam Autumn 2025
intro: BetaDev is currently holding its semiannual gamejam! If you want to create a game, learn game development or want to have some fun — join the gamejam by creating a game and show it off at BetaLAN!

theme.title: Theme
theme.text: The theme of this semester's game is **2000s retro internet**, think the MySpace era!

prizes.title: Prizes
prizes.text: There are of course prizes for the winners. The winners will be announced at BetaLAN between the 24. and 26. of October. You must showcase your game at BetaLAN to be eligible for prizes.
prizes.first: 1st place gets a prize of **1000kr** and maybe some more

rules.title: Rules
rules.technologies: You may use any technologies you want
rules.web: Being able to compile to web is a plus, so it can be shown of on BETA's
rules.recommendations: website Recommendations: godot, unity, gamemaker, pygame, p5.js to name a few.
rules.student: You must be a student at UiA Grimstad

questions.text: Questions? Ask current BETADEV leader on discord `@myrstad_` or ask in BETA's {{discord}}.
